'''Jumla Sign Language''' ({{Langx|ne|जुम्ला साङ्केतिक भाषा|translit=Jumlā Sāṅkētika Bhāṣā}}) is a [[village sign language]] of the town of [[Jumla (town)|Jumla]] in western [[Nepal]].  There is a [[Nepalese Sign Language]] school in Jumla, and that the students come from a 1–2-day walk away and do not speak Jumla Sign Language.<ref name=e18/>
